items.title: Blackstone (BX) Targets Large Scale AI Infrastructure Financing Platforms
items.summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) has entered into a new partnership with NVIDIA and several global financial institutions to develop large scale AI infrastructure financing platforms. The parties have signed memorandums of understanding that outline cooperation on funding and structuring capital for data centers and related AI infrastructure. The collaboration is intended to connect NVIDIA's AI technology capabilities with capital from Blackstone and other financial groups for long term infrastructure...
